skill.summary: Scrapes Airbnb, Vrbo, and Booking listings, analyzes pricing and reviews, and generates data-driven strategies to optimize rental revenue and marketing content.

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Airbnb and Short Term Rental Growth Engine v1.0.0

- Initial release with multi-platform short-term rental market scraping (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com) via Apify integration.
- Automated competitor analysis with dynamic pricing, occupancy, amenity, and review sentiment insights.
- Generates optimized listing text and marketing content, including property showcase videos using InVideo AI.
- Calculates revenue potential, scores your property against competitors, and produces monthly market reports.
- Example code provided for scraping, analysis, and competitive scoring to accelerate your rental business.
